page.layout: One column of running text. Marginal notes in the left margin, beside the first lines and beside "D. Petrus Messie". Small dots in the right margin, not text. Head: page number and running title. Catchword at the foot, right.

main_text.p: Can.1.de Purgat. Vulgar.tit[?] Deus, in istis duellis, innocentes in eo quo accusantur crimine succumbere & necari, propter alia eorum peccata. Quinimo non desunt exempla eorum, qui cum utrinque essent nocentes, quòd per calumniam invicem incusassent, neuter tamen succubuerit, sic ut uterque periculum evaserit. Ejus rei exemplum memorabile suppeditat Pierre Messie an les diver-ses le-cons &c.D. Petrus Messie, quod accidit tempore Alphonsi Castellæ Regis. Quidam nobilis domi militiæq; clarus, cui nomen Rupas de Vidima, Regi significaverat nobilem quem Rodiges de Avila, proditorie agere, quod in clypeo insignia gereret Portugalliæ, cum tamen esset vasal-lus Regis Castiliæ: Seque hoc ipsum vel testibus, vel singulari certamine vel alio quo probandi medio, ad quod Regis mandato obstringeretur, de-monstraturum[?] pollicetur. Hæc ut

page.notes: The first word "tit" at the top left is uncertain; it may be "sit" or "tit" as printed, so it is marked [?]. An ink blot covers part of "tempore" and of "monstraturum", so those words are read with doubt. Small dots (bullets) in the right margin, beside "Regis" and "nobilem", are marks, not text, and are left out. The faint stamp at the bottom right is a digitiser's mark and is left out.
